mechanism_narrative: A sustained acceleration in real GDP growth (GDPC1) above its 12-month moving average signals increased corporate earnings potential, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of accelerating GDP growth are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of declining industrial production are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above its 12-month moving average signals a tightening monetary cycle, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of rising interest rates are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below its 12-month moving average signals labor market tightening, increasing wage pressures and reducing corporate profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of declining unemployment are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the housing starts index (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average signals increased construction activity and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of rising housing starts are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the real sales of domestic product (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average signals economic expansion and increased corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of rising real sales are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) below its 12-month moving average signals disinflationary pressures, reducing the need for monetary tightening and supporting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of declining inflation are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above its 12-month moving average signals labor market expansion, increasing corporate earnings and supporting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of rising employment are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
